text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet-chan, thank you for the birthday 
present this year too♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"A brooch made with real flowers! It's so 
stylish, and it fits my tastes to 
perfection... It's truly full of Love♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Could this happen to be made by the same 
artisan as the pendant you gave me last 
year?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I knew it~â¡ Say, if you don't mind, 
could you introduce me to that artisan as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's totally fine if it's too much 
trouble! It's just that both last year's 
and this year's were so completely to my 
taste that I couldn't help but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"No! That's not it— ————It was me. I made 
it, with flowers and resin..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You mean Bouquet-chan made this by 
hand...!? Ah, no wonder every single 
detail hit the sweet spot of my "lovable" 
radar... !?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I just wanted to pick 
something that suits Loves-san, that's 
all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aagh... That's so romantic, totally 
adorbs...! Tell me! Tell me 
everything...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it at all...! I don't want 
you to apologize— I just want to give 
back... all that love~~!
